form.checkFields: Some fields need attention. Check the marked fields.

errors.invalid_slug: Use lowercase Latin letters, digits and dashes, e.g. old-tbilisi
errors.reserved_slug: The site already uses this name (e.g. search or hotels). Choose another name for the address
errors.invalid_url: Enter a full web address starting with https://
errors.out_of_range: This number is out of the allowed range
errors.invalid_airport: Use the 3-letter airport code, e.g. TBS
errors.ends_before_start: The end must be after the start
errors.date_in_past: Choose a date in the future
errors.date_in_future: The date can't be in the future
errors.demo_not_verifiable: A demo place can't be verified. Turn off "Demo place" or clear the date.
errors.source_required: Say where you checked the details
errors.high_below_low: The high price is lower than the low price.
errors.unit_mismatch: The kind of price doesn't fit the type.
errors.per_sqm_sale_only: A price per m² is only for sales.
errors.neighborhood_mismatch: The neighborhood is not in the chosen city.

errors.slug_taken: This address name (slug) is already used. Choose another one.
errors.city_in_use: Listings use this city, so it cannot be deleted. Switch it off instead.
errors.neighborhood_in_use: Listings use this neighborhood, so it cannot be deleted. Switch it off instead.
errors.item_not_found: This item no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.listing_not_live: Only live listings can be featured.
errors.featured_limit: There are already 48 featured listings. Remove one first.
errors.date_in_past: Choose a date in the future.
errors.last_admin: This is the last admin. Make someone else an admin first.
errors.not_allowed_on_self: You cannot change your own role.
errors.account_blocked: This account is suspended, banned or deleted.
errors.role_unchanged: This person already has this role.
errors.unknown_key: This text key does not exist any more. Reload the page.
errors.invalid_message: The text has a formatting error (check the curly braces).
errors.unknown_placeholder: The text uses a placeholder or tag that the original does not have.
errors.confirmation_mismatch: The confirmation text does not match.
errors.no_phrases: Add at least one phrase (one per line).
errors.phrase_exists: This phrase is already on the list for this language.
errors.reorder_mismatch: The list changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
errors.image_too_small: The photo is too small. Use one at least 400 pixels on the short side.
errors.image_corrupt: This file could not be read as a photo.
errors.file_type_not_allowed: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.file_scan_failed: The file could not be checked right now. Try again later.
errors.audit_failed: The action was not carried out: we could not record it in the audit log. Nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
errors.fresh_proof_required: Not done: this action needs a new code from your authenticator app.

map.hint: Click the map to place the pin, then drag it to adjust. You can also type the coordinates.

home.title: Home page sections
home.description: Choose which sections the home page shows and in what order. Changes appear for all visitors right after saving.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: A row of chips: apartments, houses and villas, rooms, hotels, for sale, kosher and Shabbat.

featured.title: Recommended places
featured.description: The promoted listings you picked, then the newest listings.

recentlyViewed.title: Recently viewed
recentlyViewed.description: Listings the visitor opened before (only on their device).

cities.title: Where to?
cities.description: Small city cards with a photo and the number of places.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description: One row of three steps for guests.

jewishLife.title: Jewish life in Georgia
jewishLife.description: A slim card linking to Shabbat times, synagogues and kosher food.

listCta.title: List your place
listCta.description: A small card that invites hosts to list for free.

home.allHidden: All sections are hidden — the home page will only show the search bar.

featured.title: Featured listings
featured.description: Hand-picked listings shown in the “Featured” section of the home page and first in search results.
featured.promotedNote: Featured listings are always labeled “Promoted” for visitors, so it is clear that they were picked by the site.
featured.addDescription: Search by listing ID or by a word from the title. Only live listings can be featured.
featured.noResults: No listings found. Check the ID or try another word.
featured.onlyLive: Only live listings can be featured
featured.currentTitle: {count, plural, =0 {Featured now} one {Featured now ({count})} other {Featured now ({count})}}
featured.emptyDescription: Search for a listing above and add it with an end date.
featured.endedRemoved: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to remove} one {{count} listing removed} other {{count} listings removed}}
featured.removeDescription: It stays live; it just stops being promoted.

cities.title: Cities and neighborhoods
cities.description: Cities appear in search, on the home page and in listing addresses. Names must be filled in Hebrew and English; the other languages fall back to English.
cities.emptyDescription: Add the first city so owners can post listings there.

new.title: New city
new.description: Fill in the names, place the city on the map and save. You can add neighborhoods after saving.

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.description: Changes show on the site right away.

cities.slugHint: Used in links, e.g. /search?city=tbilisi. Lowercase Latin letters, digits and dashes.
cities.aliasesHint: Separate with commas, e.g. tiflis, tbilissi. They help search find the city.
cities.airportHint: Used for “distance to the airport” on listings. Leave empty if there is none nearby.
cities.photoHint: A wide, bright photo works best (at least 1200 pixels wide). It is converted to WebP automatically. Only use photos you may publish.
cities.photoNeedsSlug: Fill in the address name (slug) before uploading a photo.
cities.photoUploaded: Photo uploaded. Save the city to keep it.
cities.popularHint: Shown in “Popular cities” on the home page.
cities.activeHint: Hidden cities cannot be chosen for new listings or in search.
cities.deleteCityDescription: The city and its neighborhoods are deleted permanently. Jewish places in it stay, without a city. This cannot be undone.
cities.neighborhoodsDescription: Neighborhoods of this city, used in search filters and listing addresses.
cities.neighborhoodActiveHint: Hidden neighborhoods are not offered for new listings.
cities.neighborhoodDeleteRule: Cities and neighborhoods that listings use cannot be deleted — switch them off instead.
cities.listingsCount: {count, plural, =0 {no listings} one {{count} listing} other {{count} listings}}

places.title: Jewish places
places.description: Synagogues, Chabad houses, kosher restaurants and shops, mikvaot and heritage sites. They appear on the Jewish Life page, on maps and as walking times on listings.
places.realOnly: Only add real places you have checked. Never guess an address or opening hours.

new.title: New place
new.description: Fill in the details and place the pin exactly on the entrance.

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.description: Walking times of nearby listings are updated when you save.

places.cityHint: Choose the city to move the map there.
places.name: Name
places.hoursHint: Free text, e.g. “Shacharit 8:00, Mincha at sunset”.
places.activeHint: Hidden places are not shown and do not count for walking times.
places.isDemoHint: Only for sample data. Demo places are labeled and removed with “Delete all demo data”.
places.savedWithListings: {count, plural, one {Place saved · walking times updated for {count} listing} other {Place saved · walking times updated for {count} listings}}
places.deleteDescription: It disappears from the site and from listing walking times. This cannot be undone.
places.emptyDescription: Add the synagogues, Chabad houses and kosher places you have checked.

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Only real places that have been checked are used for walking times on listings. A place without a verification date shows on the map, but not as a walking time.
verification.dateHint: The day someone on the team checked that the place exists and the address is right.
verification.sourceHint: How you checked: a phone call, a visit or the community's official site. Staff only.
verification.sourcePlaceholder: e.g. Call with the community office, Oct 30
verification.counts: This place is verified, so it counts for the walking times of nearby listings.
verification.notCounted: This place isn't verified yet, so it doesn't count for walking times.
verification.demoNever: A demo place never counts for the walking times of real listings.

articles.title: Articles
articles.description: Guides about renting, buying and living in Georgia. Write each article in Markdown in every language you can.
articles.featureOff: Articles are not shown on the site yet. They appear when the Phase 2 “articles” feature is switched on in src/config/site.ts (features.articles). You can prepare them now.
articles.featureOn: The articles feature is on: published articles are visible on the site.

new.title: New article
new.description: Save as a draft first; publish when every language is ready.

edit.title: Edit “{name}”
edit.description: Published changes are visible right away.

articles.slugHint: Used in the link, e.g. buying-property-in-georgia.
articles.coverHint: Optional. Only use images you may publish.
articles.reviewedByLawyerHint: Tick only after a local lawyer has reviewed the legal parts. Readers see a “Checked by a lawyer” note.
articles.deleteDescription: The article is deleted in every language. This cannot be undone.
articles.emptyDescription: Write the first guide, for example how to rent safely in Tbilisi.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Questions and answers in the help center, grouped by topic. Use the arrows to change the order inside a topic.
faq.dialogDescription: Write the question and answer in Hebrew and English at least; other languages fall back to English.
faq.publishedHint: Unpublished questions are not shown in the help center.
faq.question: Question
faq.emptyCategory: No questions in this topic yet.

translations.title: Interface text
translations.description: Change any text of the site without a new release. Your version replaces the text from the language files.
translations.howItWorks: Pick a section (file) and a language. The English original is shown next to the current text. Keep every placeholder in curly braces and every tag in angle brackets exactly as in the original.
translations.emptyDescription: Change the search or the filter.

alerts.title: Scam alerts
alerts.description: Warn visitors about scams that are going around right now. Active alerts are shown on the Safety page; one can also be a site-wide banner.
alerts.masterSwitchHint: Master switch: when off, no alert is shown as a banner, even if it is marked for it.
alerts.dialogDescription: Keep it short and practical: what the scam looks like and what to do instead.
alerts.endsAtHint: Leave empty to keep it until you switch it off.
alerts.activeHint: Inactive alerts are not shown anywhere.
alerts.showAsBannerHint: Shown at the top of every page while active.
alerts.emptyDescription: Add an alert when you see a new scam pattern, for example fake deposits before a viewing.

bannedWords.title: Banned words
bannedWords.description: Phrases checked in every new or edited listing, in all languages. “Flag” adds risk points (enough points send the listing to a moderator); “Block” stops publishing.
bannedWords.phraseHelp: Matching ignores capital letters, accents and niqqud. A long last word also matches its endings.

actionHints.FLAG: Adds risk points; enough points send the listing to a moderator.
actionHints.BLOCK: The listing cannot be published while it contains this phrase.

bannedWords.total: {count, plural, =0 {No phrases} one {{count} phrase} other {{count} phrases}}
bannedWords.bulkDescription: Paste one phrase per line. Duplicates and phrases already on the list are skipped.
bannedWords.bulkCount: {count, plural, =0 {No phrases yet} one {{count} phrase} other {{count} phrases}}{skipped, plural, =0 {} other { · {skipped} skipped}}
bannedWords.bulkDone: {added, plural, =0 {Nothing new added} one {{added} phrase added} other {{added} phrases added}}{skipped, plural, =0 {} other { · {skipped} skipped}}
bannedWords.emptyDescription: Add phrases scammers use, or change the filters.
bannedWords.testDescription: Paste a listing title or description to see which phrases match — the built-in scam phrases and this list. Nothing is saved.
bannedWords.testPlaceholder: e.g. Send a deposit by Western Union before the viewing
bannedWords.testBlocked: This text would be blocked from publishing.
bannedWords.testFlagged: This text would get {points} risk points.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Site-wide rules. Every change is saved in the audit log.

listings.title: Listings
listings.description: How long a listing stays live before the owner must renew it.
listings.expiryHint: 7–365 days. Owners get a reminder email a few days before.

safety.title: Trust and safety
safety.description: When listings wait for a moderator or are hidden automatically.
safety.riskThresholdHint: 0–100. Listings at or above this score wait for a moderator.
safety.reportsToHideHint: Open reports that hide a listing until a moderator checks it.
safety.scamBannerHint: The alert marked as a banner under Content → Scam alerts is shown at the top of every page.

shabbat.title: Shabbat mode
shabbat.description: By Israel time, from candle lighting until Havdalah (and on Yom Tov), posting, messaging and new support tickets pause, and visitors see a “Shabbat Shalom” banner. Browsing stays open.
shabbat.switchHint: Pauses posting, messaging and support during Shabbat and holidays.
shabbat.notNow: It is not Shabbat or a holiday in Israel right now.
shabbat.nowShabbat: It is Shabbat in Israel now, until {time} (Israel time).
shabbat.nowHoliday: It is a holiday in Israel now, until {time} (Israel time).

display.title: Currency
display.description: Prices are converted to the visitor's currency.
display.currencyHint: Used when the visitor's country and choice are unknown.

prices.title: Paid features (Phase 2)
prices.description: Prices in US dollars. Paid features are switched off in Phase 1; set the prices now so they are ready.

emergency.title: Emergency and embassy contacts
emergency.description: Shown on the Jewish Life page. Each contact needs an English label and a phone number or a website. Only add numbers you have checked.
emergency.empty: No contacts yet. Georgia's emergency number 112 is always shown.
emergency.label: Label in each language
emergency.phoneHint: As it should be dialed, e.g. +995 32 2XX XX XX

demo.title: Demo data
demo.description: Sample listings, users, places and an alert that show how the site works before real owners arrive.
demo.visibleHint: When off, demo listings are hidden from public pages. Turn off before launch.
demo.lockedOnRealSite: On the real site demo data is always hidden, even with the switch on. The switch works only on the development and test sites.
demo.counts: Demo data now — listings: {listings}, users: {users}, places: {places}, alerts: {alerts}.
demo.dangerDescription: Deleting demo data removes every demo listing, user, place and alert permanently, with their photos, messages and statistics.
demo.confirmDescription: This cannot be undone. Real listings and accounts are not touched. Type {phrase} to confirm.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Who can open the admin panel and what they can do. Every change is saved in the audit log.
roles.twoFactorWarning: Staff must turn on 2-step login (an authenticator app) before the admin panel opens for them. Changing someone's role signs them out on all devices.

roleHints.ADMIN: Everything, including settings, roles and the audit log.
roleHints.MODERATOR: Listings queue, reports, users and verifications.
roleHints.SUPPORT: Support tickets; can view users and reports.
roleHints.EDITOR: Content: home page, cities, places, articles, FAQ, alerts, banned words and interface text.

roles.selfLocked: You cannot change your own role.
roles.lastAdminLocked: The last admin cannot lose the role.
roles.removeDescription: They become a regular user and are signed out on all devices.
roles.needsTwoFactor: They need to turn on 2-step login before they can open the admin panel.
roles.addDescription: Find the person by phone number, email or name. They must already have an account.
roles.noResults: No account found. Ask the person to sign up first.

outbox.title: Email outbox
outbox.description: Every email the site sent or tried to send. In development, emails are not sent but kept here so you can check them.
outbox.previewNote: Shown in a safe frame: scripts and links are disabled.
outbox.emptyDescription: Emails appear here when someone signs up, a ticket is answered or a listing changes status.

resend.title: Send this email now?
resend.description: This email was kept on {when} and not sent, because the email service wasn't connected yet. It will now be sent as it is to {to}.
resend.failed: The email service didn't accept the email. The error is shown in the details.

blocked.not_configured: Sending again will be possible once the email service (Resend) is connected.
blocked.not_logged: Only emails that were kept and not sent can be sent again.
blocked.outbox_only: A demo account's email: the address is made up, so it is never sent.
blocked.login_code: A login code is no longer valid, so it is not sent again.
blocked.expired: A weekly summary is only sent in its own week: later its numbers are out of date, so it is not sent again.
blocked.bad_address: Email can't be sent to this address.
blocked.demo_or_test: A demo or test address (such as example.com): it doesn't really exist, so nothing is sent to it.
blocked.reply_to_lost: This email was first sent with the guest's reply address, which wasn't kept. Sent again, the host's reply wouldn't reach the guest.

outbox.waitingOnly: Only emails not really sent yet
outbox.recentOnly: {days, plural, one {From the last day} other {From the last {days} days}}

savedReplies.title: Saved replies
savedReplies.description: Ready answers for support tickets. Agents pick one in the reply box and can change it before sending.
savedReplies.dialogDescription: Write the text in Hebrew and English at least; other languages fall back to English. {placeholder} is replaced with the user's name.
savedReplies.name: Name
savedReplies.nameHint: Only staff see it, in the list of saved replies.
savedReplies.empty: No saved replies yet. Add the answers you send most often.
